meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已写或写到一半的小说导入标准项目结构，方便接着往下写
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手里有半成品或完本小说，想接着连载或拆解后重写。
copy.tagline_en: Import an existing or half-finished novel into a project structure to keep writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a half-finished or completed novel and want to keep writing it.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向拆解成拆文库，再迁移成含设定、大纲、正文、追踪的项目目录，长篇短篇按篇幅自动分流，之后可直接续写。
howto.when: 当你输入 “/story-import”，或说“导入小说”“反向解析”等指令时触发；它会先问你要导入哪本书、是只要拆文库还是要可续写工程。

say.text: 导入我的小说 ../我的书.txt，做成可续写工程
say.note: 先深度拆解，再迁移为项目结构

say.text: 这本是短篇，导入后我要接着写
say.note: 走短篇拆解管道与短篇工程结构

say.text: 导入时绑定外部对标书《XXX》
say.note: 记为该参考作品的独立拆解，与导入源分开

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reverse-parses a novel you already wrote (unfinished or complete) into a 拆文库 analysis, then migrates it into a project with settings, outline, chapters and tracking, routing long vs short by length for continued writing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /story-import or say “导入小说”, “反向解析” etc.; it first asks which book to import and whether you want an analysis or a writable project.

say_en.text: Import my novel at ../mybook.txt as a writable project
say_en.note: Analyzes first, then migrates into project structure

say_en.text: This is a short story; I want to continue writing after import
say_en.note: Uses the short-story pipeline and project layout
Recorded as a separate external reference
